Jared / Marcus — a couple clarifications from the network side after looking at the v2 diagrams:

1) Control-plane ports: confirm 443 (API), 8443 (operator telemetry), and TCP 10240-10480 for ephemeral control streams. If Acme uses an egress NAT that rewrites source ports we should expect to see source port remapping; advise static SNAT for the control-plane CIDR to avoid session mismatch.

2) BGP vs static: diagrams show both. For the initial install we recommend static routes for quicker rollback; enable BGP in phase 2. We'll publish a short BFD/MTU checklist (MTU 1500 vs jumbo 9000 note included).

3) Certificates/KMS: If Acme brings customer-managed KMS (HSM-backed), we need a service principal and a short-lived bootstrap token (valid 72h) to finalize the initial provisioning. The rotation agent will call the KMS via the control plane; firewall must allow outbound TLS to the KMS endpoint on 443.

4) Observability: ensure TCP 2003 outbound (metrics push) and port 9411+ for tracing; otherwise the control plane will operate but we won't receive agent telemetry.

I'll attach a quick port table and the MTU note in-line for the installer.

-KP
